title: Qoder: keep working on the last catalog when a background refresh fails
hypothesis: catalog_refresh_failed burns the bounded request-retry budget and reaches the user, although the previous catalog still routes.
measurement: Offline tests only (catalog-refresh.test.mjs, 22; two new cases fail with the change reverted). No model calls. Metric for the next 28-day harvest: qoder user-visible catalog_refresh_failed plus catalog_refresh_required falls from 11 of 75 to 0, with no rise in malformed-request codes.
result: Absorbs catalog_refresh_failed only when a previous catalog is loaded: no retry, reuse flagged, local expiry untouched; with no previous catalog it still surfaces, and account switches or aborts are not absorbed. Effective version: product build 0.1.27, the release that first carries this provider.mjs. The Qoder extension ships inside the product bundle, not in the Pi fork, so the fork version (1.4.0-rotom.3) is not what gates this fix; a session still running an older product build keeps the old behaviour until it is restarted on a release that contains it. Acceptance window opened 2026-11-10T13:30:07Z (local 2026-11-10 05:30): the daily install switched to product 0.1.27-main.2b4ea53b, built from commit 2b4ea53b. That release carries this provider.mjs, so the acceptance window for catalog_refresh_failed absorption opens at that moment; sessions still on the previous product build keep the old behaviour.

title: Retry policy: honour Retry-After on 429 and stop retrying quota errors
hypothesis: Retrying a 429 on the built-in backoff arrives before the server window; retrying a 402/balance error cannot succeed and hides the one action a user can take.
measurement: Offline tests only (packages/ai retry.test.ts and retry-limits.test.ts, 76 cases; 5 fail with the change reverted). No model calls. Metric for the next 28-day harvest: user-visible http and 429 failures fall from 62 + 6 of 847 provider incidents, and no quota error costs more than one attempt.
result: 429 delays use retryAfterMs or Retry-After, capped at the existing maximum, with exponential backoff as fallback; quota/402/balance errors are non-retryable and the final message adds one actionable hint. Bounded and connect retry unchanged. Correction from round 4: this shipped only as source at first push. The Pi fork was not rebuilt then, so the runtime the product loads still had the old retry path; 8204224 alone could not change behaviour. commit 6ae816d7 rebuilt the fork as 1.4.0-rotom.3 (vendored archives, fork-build.json, runtime/pi lock, product-config version and integrity all follow it), and an isolated install from that lockfile greps the new code in the installed pi-ai dist. The acceptance window therefore starts the day the daily install is switched to 1.4.0-rotom.3, not the day of 8204224. Acceptance window opened 2026-11-10T13:30:07Z (local 2026-11-10 05:30): the daily install switched to product 0.1.27-main.2b4ea53b, built from commit 2b4ea53b. That release carries Pi fork 1.4.0-rotom.3, so the acceptance window for the Retry-After and quota behaviour opens at that moment rather than at 8204224.
